title: C.A.R.E
summary: The acronym I use every day to remind myself what my job is as a leader: Clarity, Alignment, Resources, and Emotional connectedness.
quote: Teams exist to do what individuals cannot. Leaders exist to maximize team performance.

title: Looking Back, I'm Embarrassed
summary: A friend on my team in Baghdad told me to stop being so negative. Fifteen years later, the things I complained about look petty, and there is a name for why hard times feel better in memory.
quote: Rarely does complaining make it better. By complaining, we are complicit.

title: The Last Time...
summary: A little girl melting down at baggage claim made me realize I can't remember the last time I picked up my youngest son.
quote: We never know when it will be the last time.

title: Taking The Longview (On People)
summary: This one is spoken, not written. It's about taking the long view on people.

title: The Hardest Thing
summary: Lincoln held the country together through the Civil War while fighting depression. Managing your own psychology is the first job of a leader, and the hardest.
quote: Our teams need our calm and clarity, not our stress-induced imagination.

title: How you think about compensation will shape your life
summary: Compensation comes in three forms: economic, educational, and emotional. Told through the story of why I joined the Army.
quote: The one truly non-renewable resource we have is time.

title: What If You Got Fired?
summary: If I got fired, what would the next person do? A question for seeing your own job the way an outsider would.
quote: Almost everything gets better with an outside perspective.
